instructions.zh: 请用清晰、稳重、亲切的普通话女声，给客户介绍一个股票研究工具。语速适中，自然口语化，短句间留出轻微停顿，每个字的声母和韵母发音完整。买入、筛选、摘要、休市、提醒这些词要说清楚。不要抢拍，不要吞字，不要刻意拖长尾音，不要广告或新闻播音腔。
instructions.en: Use a clear, warm, professional female voice. Speak natural conversational English at a moderately brisk pace, with short pauses. Calm, confident product walkthrough, without sales emphasis or sing-song intonation.

delivery.status: Plain-word Chinese articulation audition; only replace after independent review. English remains the verified original.

scenes.name: 03-creators
scenes.zh: 查看博主解读，点开时间点听原话。再看价格图表，回看后来的涨跌。
scenes.en: Read a creator summary and jump to the original video. Use the price chart to review what happened afterward.

scenes.name: 05-alerts
scenes.zh: 开启提醒，条件满足时通知你。先免费加一只股票，开始体验。
scenes.en: Set an alert and get notified when your conditions are met. Start free with one stock.
